subject: ddl: support to set and alter the `AFFINITY` for table (#64988)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs parent, limited to `pkg/parser` and `pkg/executor`. Parser adds unreserved keyword `AFFINITY`, grammar support as a table option (including TiDB special comment feature-id `affinity`), and AST restore support; executor adds `TIDB_AFFINITY` to `INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES/PARTITIONS` output and emits `/*T![affinity] AFFINITY='...' */` in SHOW CREATE TABLE. Checked later history on `upstream/master` for follow-up fixes touching these areas; no subsequent changes indicate a Blocker/High issue in the reviewed surface.
